items.evidence: README board-3 script (--board 3 --ticks 1500 "0:right,20:none,20:right,80:none") ends screen play, board 4, score 30, texts 'Board 4 of 4' (not won). --board 4 --ticks 0 gives ball (-3,1.25,0), coins (-2,0),(2.2,0),(3.5,1.5); the frame shows the slab and the tilted ramp; --board accepts 4.

Rolling up works: with "0:right,80:none" on board 4 the ball has y 0.519 at x -0.27 (tick 71) and y 0.975 at x 1.03 (tick 92). But the ramp is not solid from the side: --board 4 --ticks 351 --inputs "0:none,80:down,120:up,160:right,222:left,281:none,300:up,330:none" rolls the ball at y 0.25 through the ramp's side from z 1.2 to z -1.3 at x 0.74-0.8, where the ramp top is about 0.6. The state at tick 351 is ball (0.74, 0.25, -0.01), and the frame shows the ball hidden inside the ramp. A ball rolled -x at the ramp's 0.7-high end also passes straight through (sim._ramp only handles the top plane).

out/checks/board4_win_inputs.txt with --board 4 --ticks 300: coin (2.2,1.2,0) is taken at tick 102 with the ball at (1.73, 1.04, 0), past the ramp's end and in the air. The last coin is taken at tick 216. Final state: screen won, score 30, sounds end with coin, clear. Enter then returns to the title.
--board 1..4 --ticks 1 in en/es/fr: 'Board N of 4', 'Tablero N de 4', 'Plateau N sur 4' for N=1..4; the play and paused frames show the same text.

Language Right cycles en->es->fr->en and Left goes en->fr. In fr the state texts and frames for title, settings, play, paused, won and lost are all French: Commencer/Reglages/Quitter, Volume :/Langue : Francais/Balle : Normale/Retour, Plateau 1 sur 4/Score :/Vies :, Pause/Reprendre/Retour au titre, Vous avez gagne, Fin de partie, Appuyez sur Entree... language is fr. Only the game name 'Roll' is unchanged, as in Spanish.

Settings items are Volume, Language, Ball, Back. The default is Normal. menu_left gives light and menu_right gives heavy (it wraps). ball_kind in the state follows the setting. It shows as 'Bola: Pesada' in es and 'Balle : Legere' in fr, in the state and in the frames.

Board 2 with "60:right,120:none" and ball_kind light/normal/heavy: the ball x at tick 128 (just before reaching the crates) is -0.5088 for all three. The sum of crate displacements 120 ticks after the strike is light 0.204, normal 0.564, heavy 3.912 (CLI shows the same light 0.204 and heavy 3.912). With "0:right,150:none": light 0.47, heavy 3.8 plus one crate knocked off.

After menu_left on Ball, settings.json is {volume 8, language en, ball_kind light}, and a fresh run with that folder starts with ball_kind light. Language and volume are kept with it. An old-style file {"volume":3,"language":"es"} loads as volume 3, es, ball_kind normal.

Re-ran m01-m21, m23 and m24. All pass: JSON-file inputs work; output is byte-identical over two runs (PNG too); frames are 800x480; 4 distinct non-silent WAVs of 0.25/0.18/0.9/0.8 s. Menus and volume clamp 0..10 work. Board 1 idle: lands at tick 27, rebounds, y 0.25 at 600, 3 bounces. Pushes go the right way and the ball coasts. A coin adds 10; clearing board 1 gives board 2 with 6 crates and lives kept. Crates hold within 0.0004 for 300 ticks. A strike moves 4 crates more than 0.3 and slows the ball (x=1 at tick 110 vs 85 on an empty board); a crate falls off and leaves the list. A fall keeps the coins already taken. bridge_x reads 1,2,1,0. The bridge carries the ball within 0.088, and a ball pushed into the gap falls. Board 3 then board 4 scripts give won with score 60, and the screen stays frozen. Lost and paused screens freeze the game; Quit to title works. The Spanish screens are all Spanish.

--board 4 --ticks 1 --frame: an 800x480 PNG (header checked). It shows the checkered slab, the ramp as a brown tilted slab with a visible thickness edge, the ball with its shadow at the start, and the three coins (the one in the air beyond the ramp).

CHANGES.md lists each change with its files and functions (sim.py BOARDS[4]/_ramp/TEXT fr/SETTINGS_ITEMS/BALL_MASS, render.py, font.py, roll.py), what was checked and how, problems found before the change, and the ambiguities in the brief.

defects: Board 4 ramp only has a top plane: a ball enters it through the sides (|z|=1) and through the 0.7-high end face at x=1, and can sit hidden inside it.
A strong push on board 4 (right held 80+ ticks from the start) launches the ball over the ramp and off the far end of the slab, costing a life (it is a long jump, so this may be intended).
Pre-existing, noted by the builder: ball against slab sides is not modelled.
